## Contributing to SpessaFont

First, I want to thank you for wanting to help develop SpessaFont.
I really appreciate your contribution :-)

Here are some tips about contributing:

### Reporting a bug

Use the GitHub issue forms and please avoid using the "Blank" template unless absolutely necessary.

### Contributing a patch/enhancement

Run `npm run build` before opening a pull request. It runs ESLint, the TypeScript type check, the Vitest tests and the Vite build.

### Translations

Please see [the locale README](../src/locale/README.md) if you want to contribute a new translation.

### License notice

When submitting a pull request to `SpessaFont`, you are giving [Spessasus](https://github.com/spessasus) the right to license
your contributions under the [Apache License 2.0](../LICENSE), and you irrevocably permit a potential
future re-licensing of `SpessaFont`, containing your contributions, under any open source license.
